title: CityBuildingDef
description:
A city building definition from JSON type `"city_building"`.

Defines a building that can be placed in a city during overmap generation, specifying its location type and overmap tiles.

locations.description: Location types where this building can be placed (e.g. ["land"]).

overmaps.description: Overmap tile placements for this building.

CityBuildingOvermap.description: A single overmap tile placement within a city building.

overmap.description: Overmap terrain ID to place at this position (e.g. "bungalow01_1_north").

point.description: Grid position [x, y, z] relative to the building's origin.
